case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Dear Mr Moser,

thank you for your offer and for twelve years of reliable supply. We would like to settle this in a way that works for both sides. A two-year commitment gives you planning security; in return we ask for the package below.

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We highly value our twelve-year partnership and appreciate your proposal for a 24-month commitment, which offers valuable planning security.
We are pleased to accommodate the extended contract term and the later effective date of 1 February 2027.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your improved offer; it shows we are working in the right direction. Over the years, our long relationship has built a foundation of trust that we deeply value here in our family foundry. 

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. I am willing to make a further step to meet you, reducing our price to €50.70 per unit. Please understand that this is a significant concession on our part, and we are reaching the limits of what is possible for us. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Besides a price of €50.70 per unit, our Angebot includes a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your continued movement and your commitment to finding a solution. In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, I am making another step towards you and can offer a price of €50.30 per unit. Along with this unit price, this Angebot includes a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and is valid from 1 February 2027. 

Please understand that we are now very close to the absolute limit of what our family foundry can accommodate. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
